visual.general_description: A text timeline of Case 2: history three and two years before, the presentation, the surgery with a preserved scleral patch and the postoperative IOP course through day 24.
visual.detailed_description: Panel None: Black text on a white background with five bold headings in order: Three years prior, Two years prior, Current presentation, Surgery using the preserved screlal patch, and Postoperative course. Short vertical black lines run on the left between headings. Under Three years prior is one line about bilateral supratemporal trabeculectomy with 0.04% MMC for 3 minutes for primary open-angle glaucoma. Under Two years prior is a line about filtering bleb infection in the right eye managed with three bullets (anterior chamber irrigation, intravitreal antibiotic injection, conjunctival resection), and the third bullet line continues with the sentence Surgical revision included scleral coverage and conjunctival rotation. Under Current presentation is a line listing decreased visual acuity (logMAR 0.4), IOP 4 mmHg, aqueous leakage, scleral flap melting and choroidal detachment. Under the surgery heading is a line stating the preserved scleral patch was applied to the area of the dissolved scleral flap. Under Postoperative course are five bullets: immediate resolution of leakage and choroidal detachment; Day 1 IOP rose to 44 mmHg followed by an arrow to acetazolamide plus topical therapy; Day 2 IOP decreased to 12 mmHg; Day 6 IOP increased again to 20 mmHg and remained elevated; Day 24 AGV insertion surgery was performed due to persistent IOP elevation. No images, axes or patient identifiers are printed.
